services.title: Elderly home assistance
services.short: A familiar face. A little more ease.
services.alt: A Black home support worker speaking with an older woman in a modest Kigali home.
services.description: Companionship and practical help with agreed everyday routines, shaped around the person’s preferences and independence. Tell us what would make visits feel comfortable, familiar and useful for your family member.
includes: Conversation, companionship and time together
Help with agreed meals and everyday routines
Accompaniment when arranged with your family
A visit update through the agreed communication channel
services.boundaries: This is non-medical home assistance. It does not include nursing, diagnosis, clinical advice, medication administration or emergency response. Discuss any task that may involve a health risk with the team before requesting it.
services.prepare: Tell us what kind of support would help, the preferred visit times and any accessibility or communication preferences. We will agree the specific duties and family contact arrangements before a visit is confirmed.
services.cardAlt: A Black family supporting an older relative at home.

services.title: Babysitting & childcare
services.short: Their little world, thoughtfully cared for.
services.alt: A Black caregiver reading with a young child in a bright family home.
services.description: Attentive childcare support planned around your family’s routines, the child’s age and the handover arrangements you choose. We discuss expectations with a parent or guardian before a booking is confirmed.
includes: Supervision and age-appropriate play
Meals and daily routines agreed with a parent
Parent-approved arrival and handover arrangements
Communication during the agreed service hours
services.boundaries: Age suitability, service hours and provider requirements are reviewed for each request. A parent or guardian must authorize the care and agree handover contacts before confirmation; the service is not an emergency childcare arrangement.
services.prepare: Share the child’s age range, preferred hours and the routines you want the provider to follow. A parent or guardian should agree the authorized handover contacts and any important instructions privately with the team.
services.cardAlt: A Black parent playing with a young child at home.

services.title: Home cooking
services.short: Good food. One less thing on your list.
services.alt: A Black home cook preparing a meal with fresh ingredients in a Kigali kitchen.
services.description: Meals prepared in your own kitchen around the dishes your household enjoys and the time you have available. We discuss the number of people, kitchen setup and ingredients so the agreed work is clear before the visit.
includes: Meal preparation in your home
Menu or meal-planning support when agreed
Food preferences and dietary needs discussed in advance
A clear kitchen handover after preparation
services.boundaries: Ingredients, kitchen equipment, cleaning materials and any additional costs are agreed before the booking. Food-handling suitability is part of provider review; the service does not replace medical nutrition advice.
services.prepare: Tell us how many people the meals are for, what kind of food you prefer and who will provide ingredients. Please discuss allergies directly with the team before service so the practical arrangements can be reviewed.
services.cardAlt: A Black woman preparing a meal in a home kitchen.

services.title: Home cleaning
services.short: A fresh home. A lighter day.
services.alt: A Black cleaning professional carefully tidying a family living room.
services.description: Practical cleaning for the rooms and surfaces your household uses every day. We agree a simple task list, priorities, supplies and access arrangements so everyone understands what will be covered during the visit.
includes: Routine room and surface cleaning
Kitchen and bathroom tasks agreed in the checklist
Priorities set around the rooms you use most
Supplies and equipment discussed before arrival
services.boundaries: Specialist cleaning, hazardous materials and work at height need separate review. Please mention unusual surfaces or equipment in your private conversation so the team can confirm whether the requested work is suitable.
services.prepare: Tell us which rooms matter most and whether you will provide cleaning products or equipment. We will review the checklist, access arrangements and time needed before confirming the visit.
services.cardAlt: A Black home support worker cleaning a family home.

services.title: Home drivers
services.short: A dependable ride, arranged around your day.
services.alt: A Black home driver helping an older passenger into a car before a planned journey.
services.description: Home driving can help with planned journeys, appointments and household errands. We discuss the date, route, vehicle arrangement and passenger needs with you before confirming any trip.
includes: A driver for a journey agreed in advance
Pick-up timing and route discussed with the household
Vehicle arrangements clarified before the trip
A clear contact plan for journey updates
services.boundaries: Driver licence, availability, vehicle, insurance and journey details must be reviewed and agreed before any trip is confirmed. Submitting a request does not confirm a ride or reserve a vehicle.
services.prepare: Share the general area, preferred time and type of journey first. Exact addresses, passenger details and sensitive travel information are best shared privately with the team while the route and vehicle arrangements are reviewed.
services.cardAlt: A Black home driver standing beside a family car in Kigali.

services.title: Home security
services.alt: A Black home security professional speaking with a homeowner at a gate.
services.description: Discuss household security needs and the kind of coverage you are considering. We review the responsibilities, hours, access process and service requirements before advising whether an arrangement can be considered.
includes: A conversation about household coverage needs
Visitor and access procedures agreed with you
A duty schedule and handover plan discussed
A clear route for household updates or incident reports
services.boundaries: Security assignments require suitable personnel, approved operating arrangements and any applicable licensing. A request is reviewed before availability or service scope can be confirmed; do not rely on this service for emergency response.
services.prepare: Discuss the property, hours, access procedures and responsibilities with the team. Do not send alarm codes, detailed layouts or security-sensitive arrangements through the public request form.
services.cardAlt: Black security professionals at the entrance of a modest home.

howItWorks.eyebrow: A clear handover from request to visit
howItWorks.title: Three accounts. One coordinated service.
howItWorks.intro: The family account shares what support is needed. Management reviews the request, agrees the plan and assigns an employee. The employee account carries the confirmed visit details and sends progress back through the service team.
howItWorks.imageAlt: A family, service coordinator and employee reviewing the stages of a home visit together.

steps.title: 1. The family sends a request
steps.text: From the family account, a household chooses a service, shares broad timing and location, and explains what would help. The request starts a conversation; it does not confirm a booking.

steps.title: 2. Management reviews the request
steps.text: The management account is used to clarify the household’s needs, check service suitability and availability, and discuss duties, timing, boundaries and the quote with the family.

steps.title: 3. The family agrees the plan
steps.text: The family reviews the proposed service, schedule, price and arrangements. Management confirms the booking only after the household and team agree the details.

steps.title: 4. Management assigns an employee
steps.text: Management matches the confirmed work with an available employee and links that assignment to the family’s booking. The employee account shows the assigned visit and the instructions needed for that work.

steps.title: 5. The employee completes the visit
steps.text: The employee uses their account to see the schedule, record arrival and completion, and submit the visit update. They see the information needed for the assignment, rather than managing the family’s account.

steps.title: 6. The family and team follow up
steps.text: Relevant visit updates appear with the family’s arrangement. The family can contact management about a question or change; management coordinates the response and any revised assignment.

howItWorks.accountsTitle: Each account has a clear role
howItWorks.accountsIntro: Management connects the family’s agreed request to the employee’s assigned work, so everyone has the information needed for their part.

accounts.label: FAMILY ACCOUNT
accounts.title: The household’s service view
accounts.text: The family shares a request, reviews the agreed plan and follows the service from a private account.
points: Send a service request and preferred timing
Review booking details, messages and invoices
Follow visit updates and contact management about changes

accounts.label: EMPLOYEE ACCOUNT
accounts.title: The assigned work view
accounts.text: The employee sees the visits assigned to them and records the progress of each confirmed service.
points: View their schedule and job-specific instructions
Record arrival, completion and a service update
Raise questions or concerns through the team

accounts.label: MANAGEMENT ACCOUNT
accounts.title: The coordination view
accounts.text: The team reviews requests, agrees the service with the household and manages the employee assignment.
points: Check suitability, availability and service boundaries
Agree the duties, schedule and quote with the family
Assign an employee and coordinate follow-up

howItWorks.connectionText: The family’s request is received by management first. Once the plan is agreed, management links an employee and the visit to that booking. The employee records progress on the assigned visit; management keeps the family informed through the booking’s updates and messages. Any change to the plan goes back through management, so the family and employee are working from the same confirmed arrangement.
howItWorks.accountTitle: A private place for the household
howItWorks.accountText: The family account keeps the agreed service, visit updates, messages, invoices and feedback together.

Good support begins

faq.title: A few helpful answers.
faq.intro: Find practical answers about requests, quotes, visit arrangements and communication. If your question is specific to your household, contact Mary and the team directly.

items.question: Is my request a confirmed booking?
items.answer: No. A request tells us what you are looking for; it does not reserve a provider or time. The team will review the service, discuss suitability and availability, agree the duties and quote with you, and confirm the booking only when you both agree.

items.question: How much does home assistance cost?
items.answer: Prices depend on the service, duration and location. We prepare a quote after discussing the work and any relevant transport, supplies, ingredients or other costs. You can review the full proposed price before deciding whether to confirm.

items.question: Who will come to my home?
items.answer: The team discusses a suitable available provider with you after reviewing the service needs and relevant requirements. Once an arrangement is confirmed, the provider and agreed duties are shared through your private account or direct communication.

items.question: Can I request regular help?
items.answer: You can tell us the routine you would prefer, including days and approximate times. The team will review the schedule and confirm what is available. A recurring request does not hold time that has not been agreed.

items.question: Do you provide medical or emergency services?
items.answer: No. Elderly home assistance is non-medical and does not replace nursing, clinical advice or emergency response. If someone needs urgent medical help, contact an appropriate emergency service.

items.question: How do payments work?
items.answer: The team explains payment options and timing when you review the quote. Invoices and any supported payment records are available in your account. If online payment is enabled for your booking, use the secure payment page; do not send card details in a message or request form.

items.question: Can I change or cancel a visit?
items.answer: Contact the team as soon as plans change. You can request a change or cancellation from your account, and the team will review the schedule and applicable terms with you. A requested change is not confirmed until you receive a response.

items.question: How is attendance verified?
items.answer: For an assigned visit, the provider records arrival and departure for attendance. GPS is used at those check-in and check-out moments, rather than as continuous location tracking. Visit updates are available in your private account.

privacy.label: Privacy notice
privacy.title: Your privacy matters.
privacy.intro: A plain-language summary of how this platform handles your information.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Booking enquiries use your contact details, service choice, neighbourhood and preferred schedule. Private accounts hold the household details and service records needed to coordinate agreed care. Provider applications and private screening documents are reviewed by authorized staff.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: We use this information to review requests, coordinate services, manage attendance and payments, communicate with you and respond to concerns. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Who can see it
sections.body: Families can see their own household and service records. Assigned workers receive the information needed for their work. Authorized administrators and operations staff have access appropriate to their responsibilities. Private staff documents are not public.

sections.title: Location and payments
sections.body: Location is requested when a worker records arrival or departure for an assigned visit. Continuous tracking outside assignments is not enabled. Online payments, when available, use a hosted payment provider; the platform does not collect card details.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: Use the contact page to request access, correction or deletion of personal information, or to raise a privacy concern. Retention periods, the business data-controller details and any applicable exceptions must be finalized by the business before live service.

privacy.status: Policy summary · Final business approval required before live service

terms.label: Service terms
terms.title: Clear expectations. Better care.
terms.intro: The service relationship should be understood before a visit is confirmed.

sections.title: Requests and confirmation
sections.body: A service request is an enquiry. A booking is confirmed only after the team and household agree availability, provider suitability, duties, price and applicable terms.

sections.title: Service boundaries
sections.body: Home assistance is not clinical care or emergency response. The agreed scope determines what the provider can do. Childcare requires parent or guardian authorization and agreed handover contacts. Security services depend on approved legal and operational arrangements.

sections.title: Household responsibilities
sections.body: Provide accurate information, a safe service environment and the supplies or equipment agreed in the booking. Inform the team about changes that affect the service through your private account or contact channel.

sections.title: Provider responsibilities
sections.body: Providers must complete the required screening for their category, follow agreed instructions and safeguarding requirements, record attendance and report incidents or problems promptly.

sections.title: Before live service
sections.body: The business must approve its final contracts, identity, registration details, insurance arrangements and locally reviewed terms. This platform summary is not a replacement for those agreements.

terms.status: Policy summary · Final business approval required before live service

cancellations.label: Changes & cancellations
cancellations.title: When plans change.
cancellations.intro: We understand that life does not always follow a schedule.

sections.title: Requesting a change
sections.body: Open the relevant service in your family account to request a date, time or duration change, or cancellation. Explain the change so the team can review availability and respond.

sections.title: Approval and timing
sections.body: A submitted change does not alter a confirmed booking until the team approves it. You will receive an update in your account when a decision is recorded.

sections.title: Fees and refunds
sections.body: The applicable notice period, cancellation fee and refund eligibility must be agreed before the original booking is confirmed. We do not publish unapproved amounts or promise a refund before review.

sections.title: Refund records
sections.body: Approved refunds are recorded against the original payment. The team will confirm the method and reference; actual settlement depends on the approved payment arrangement.

cancellations.status: Policy summary · Final business approval required before live service

safeguarding.label: Safeguarding
safeguarding.title: Care begins with respect.
safeguarding.intro: A safe home-care experience requires clear standards and a way to speak up.

sections.title: Screening and suitability
sections.body: Identity, references, experience and category-specific qualifications must be reviewed before a worker is approved for the relevant service. Applying or creating an account does not by itself grant assignment eligibility.

sections.title: Children and authorized handovers
sections.body: Childcare requires parent or guardian authorization, approved contacts and an agreed arrival/departure process. Children’s photographs and personal information must not be published without explicit informed permission.

sections.title: Dignity and service boundaries
sections.body: Respect privacy, independence, personal boundaries and the agreed duties. Non-medical home assistance must not be represented as nursing, medication administration or emergency medical support.

sections.title: Reporting a concern
sections.body: Families can raise a concern from their account. Workers can submit incident or technical reports for an assigned visit. The team reviews, assigns responsibility and records follow-up. For immediate danger, use the appropriate local emergency service.

sections.title: Operational readiness
sections.body: The business must approve its final safeguarding procedures, escalation contacts, training, insurance and service-specific operating standards before accepting live bookings.

safeguarding.status: Policy summary · Final business approval required before live service
